address: 3-4F, Building Raidy Boer, 222 Shanbanqiao Road, Chenghua, Chengdu, China Mainland
bio: Although there are only six tables in the main dining room, there are private rooms with solariums, balconies and tea brewing rooms spread over two floors. A stylish, peaceful vibe reigns throughout the spacious, comfortable interior. The kitchen team crafts a menu of traditional Sichuanese fare such as fuqi feipian – sliced beef brisket and tripe in Sichuan pepper sauce. Their signature spicy pork belly, slow-cooked in an earthen jar over a wood fire, is rich and flavoursome....
